5d2a41ccf2774393-b8a81426acc08b99-f277-4.name: Midgame Progression
5d2a41ccf2774393-b8a81426acc08b99-f277-4.desc: Midgame Progression, involving Oil and early Nuclear.

4b5ae4f13ac340c8-903a1f2175ffd5de-3ac3-4.name: Progression
4b5ae4f13ac340c8-903a1f2175ffd5de-3ac3-4.desc: Progression, from start to finish in NTM!

8ea77a8c9b2c4b52-b91c1f6e7c4e109a-9b2c-4.name: Science!
8ea77a8c9b2c4b52-b91c1f6e7c4e109a-9b2c-4.desc: Learning about all the NTM mechanics!

78e8a3ee4eb742bf-a1e745d14b119934-4eb7-4.name: AE2
78e8a3ee4eb742bf-a1e745d14b119934-4eb7-4.desc:
§9Applied Energistics 2§r is a very §6OP§r but hard to get logistics option in the pack. It offers §rtoo many features to be encapsulated in one quest like this, but this is just as a note, as you can unlock it later.

Note, though, in this pack specifically you may be able to find bits and bobs of a basic AE2 system in §brare loot§r, allowing you to get easy storage much easier.

d446e64d85ad49ac-b9fce7030bfa1b87-85ad-4.name: Air Intake
d446e64d85ad49ac-b9fce7030bfa1b87-85ad-4.desc:
The§b Air Intake§r is an electrical machine that creates a constant flow of §aCompressed Air§r.
§aCompressed Air§r is used for various purposes, like §6Pneumatics§r, but most importantly for now it can be heated in a §c[quest]Boiler[/quest]§r for §6Hot Air§  Blas§rt, which significantly speeds up the processing of the§r §9[quest]Blast Furnace[/quest]§r.

d6daff203f9042cb-801196c13ae2a034-3f90-4.name: Analog Circuit Boards
d6daff203f9042cb-801196c13ae2a034-3f90-4.desc:
Your first circuit boards. Congratulations!

§6Analog Circuit Boards§r are a key electronical component, used in a lot of different machines, items, and components' recipes.
 
They are also going to be used a lot in the next chapter. Thus, i suggest you craft §632§r in advance. It's a reasonable amount, helping you get through §6Oil§r comfortably. 

In exchange, i'll give you my &qHead§r. What? Oh, i meant my §6Bobblehead§r.

25cde55a5f3648c9-ac77da31bbbbd36f-5f36-4.name: Anthracite
25cde55a5f3648c9-ac77da31bbbbd36f-5f36-4.desc: Need coal? Well, §6Anthracite§r is a highly dense source of§9 Coal§r. Mining it spawns §aCoal Dust§r, so wearing a §6Mask§r is recommended. It drops chunks by default which can be used as fuel, but later on, shredding it will yield §8Coal Dust§r, which can then be turned into§6 Coa§r§6l.§r

3c3ec226a3f04d2e-baf0d5e166781bb0-a3f0-4.name: Arc Welder
3c3ec226a3f04d2e-baf0d5e166781bb0-a3f0-4.desc:
The §6Arc Welder§r is an electrical machine used for creating§6 Welded Plates§r. Welded Plates are created from 2 [quest]Cast Plates[/quest], and are equivalent to 6 ingots each.

This machine is also important for creating various§6 missile§r components, and also is required for making§9 [quest]Dense Wire[/quest]§r.

c3211f182cb042b9-ae6d8fdea8b70802-2cb0-4.name: Armor Modifications
c3211f182cb042b9-ae6d8fdea8b70802-2cb0-4.desc:
§6Armor Modifications§r are certain attachments you can place onto certain pieces of your armor via an§c Armor Modification Table§r.

§9Armor Mods§6§r§r provide various utilities, most have to be placed on specific slots on specific §r§rpieces of your armor. Some of these may be §cmutually exclusive§r, so you have to be wise about what mods you want to apply.

0ccfd0c08f5c4ff1-853332b6fe7327c4-8f5c-4.name: Assembly Machine
0ccfd0c08f5c4ff1-853332b6fe7327c4-8f5c-4.desc:
The §6Assembly Machine§r is an electrical machine that is very important for crafting most of the machines and components in NTM.

It is able to accept power and items from any side, and it has 9 input slots. 

To craft a recipe inside of it, you first need to select it in the §6recipe browser§r in the bottom of the machine. This allows you to §eselect§r the recipe, and then ghost previews of the required items will show up in the slots.

This machine also accepts§9 Blueprint§r§9s§r, which provide special recipes unique to each blueprint when placed in the blueprint slot. You can get Blueprints via§9 Blueprint Booklets§r, found in structures.

3c525918f62245bf-ba7f0187b416e419-f622-4.name: Automatic Buzz Saw
3c525918f62245bf-ba7f0187b416e419-f622-4.desc:
The§6 Automatic Buzz Saw §ris a machine that harvests Trees, Hemp, and Mustard Willow. 

It constantly passively spins in a circle around it, and only extends if there is a tree that can be chopped. When a tree is detected, it extends its Sawblade and cuts down the tree, dropping all of its items and replanting the sapling in the process.

It uses liquid fuels, but usually, things that you can harvest produce these fuels if you §areprocess§r them, so you can make an infinite loop. Some of these fuels are §9Wood Oil§r, §bEthanol§r, §aFish Oil§r, and §eHeavy Oil§r.

66708c7f00a14752-9b89efe5556a1c49-00a1-4.name: Automatic Thresher
66708c7f00a14752-9b89efe5556a1c49-00a1-4.desc:
The §9§6Automatic Thresher§r§r is a machine that can be used to automate various crops.

It extends its blades and harvests in a §67x7§r area infront of it, replanting crops if broken, and working with double-height crops like§c Sugar Cane§r and §cHemp§r too.
 
It outputs from the back directly, allowing you to route items from there on.

It uses liquid fuels, but usually, things that you can harvest produce these fuels if you §areprocess§r them, so you can make an infinite loop. Some of these fuels are §9Wood Oil§r, §bEthanol§r, §aFish Oil§r, and §eHeavy Oil§r.

f4b4940fb8c94901-94f6f7680a56e310-b8c9-4.name: Battery Sockets
f4b4940fb8c94901-94f6f7680a56e310-b8c9-4.desc:
§6Battery Sockets§r are blocks which allow you to place §6Batteries§r in them. Batteries are blocks that, when inserted into a battery socket, allow you to Store energy inside them. Unlike regular cables however, the throughput of the Batteries depends on what §6tier§r it is, so it isn't infinite.

Batteries also can connect to each other as if they were a multiblock. They can be found in §astructures§r, and their UI also has input/output modes to choose how you want to route your energy.

8b5acb1b11014c1d-9a526eff9a07452f-1101-4.name: Better Furnaces

894cae552bb44f55-8a191cd25beb97e2-2bb4-4.name: Blast Furnace
894cae552bb44f55-8a191cd25beb97e2-2bb4-4.desc:
After crafting some §6[quest]Firebrick[/quest]§r using some of the §3Raw Aluminium§r you've found, it's time to make your first multiblock: The Blast Furnace.

The §2Blast Furnace§r inputs §3Coal§r as a fuel/carbon source and outputs various§3 alloys§r, allowing you to create§7 Steel§r,§c Red Copper§r, and more efficient§6 Firebricks§r.

However, this multiblock is very slow.. But, as soon as you get electricity, you are able to make an§b [quest]Air Intake[/quest]§r. Heating up air that comes from this intake in a §a[quest]Boiler[/quest]§r leads to §4Hot Air Blast§r, which can be used to drastically§b speed up§r the recipes and also generate a bit of burnable§c Flue Gas§r.

819d483466b34a3f-aec2aabad00f01da-66b3-4.name: Bobmazon
819d483466b34a3f-aec2aabad00f01da-66b3-4.desc:
§9Bobmazon§r is a shop which uses §cCaps§r for currency. To unlock certain bobmazon trades, you will need to acquire a certain achievement, listed in the slot below the item you wish to purchase.

&qFun Fact§r: There is a secret version of Bobmazon called the Hidden Catalog. To access it you need to solve a riddle, but the answers are encrypted... Good luck solving them!

4b4412c3dc6f43a0-b8df43d1fc6936c2-dc6f-4.name: Boiler
4b4412c3dc6f43a0-b8df43d1fc6936c2-dc6f-4.desc:
The §9Boiler§r is a heat-based machine that heats up fluids inside it. It has an internal tank of §c16,000mB§r of fluid, which may change depending on how much the fluid inside it expands when heated.

§6Right-Clicking§r it with a §6[quest]Fluid Identifier[/quest]§r can change the fluid input it uses, so as to change its recipe.

If its output buffer is full, it will §6explode§r, leaving the machine inoperable.

ec432d010f1141a9-a82e196c1c2b4156-0f11-4.name: Burner Press
ec432d010f1141a9-a82e196c1c2b4156-0f11-4.desc:
The §6Burner Press§r is a basic machine used for creating§6 Plates§r, §cWires§r, and other stamped products. You need fuel to make sure it works, and also a stamp for that specific recipe.

Different recipes require different stamps in order to work. You make stamps in the §6Anvil§r.

§4NOTE§r: You can place a Preheater next to the press to increase its speed.

606f52b97ca544a0-b38df2f0a1b1cd38-7ca5-4.name: Cast Plates
606f52b97ca544a0-b38df2f0a1b1cd38-7ca5-4.desc:
§6Cast Plates §rare made exclusively via casting molten materials in the Cast Plate mold.

They equate to 3 ingots of any material, and are used extensively in further recipes. Thus, a large task i have to assign to you now is to batch-craft§6 32§r of any Cast Plate... Though, the reward will be even handsomer this time, i promise.

If you're wondering how to get the mold in the first place, the Iron Cast Plate + Blank Mold recipe works, as you can craft the Iron Cast Plate in a crafting table.

&qFun Fact§r: The Triple Cast Plate mold was my first suggestion to NTM!

bf60c33bdf7949a6-9c41cd43f207e8e1-df79-4.name: Charcoal Automation
bf60c33bdf7949a6-9c41cd43f207e8e1-df79-4.desc:
You can automate Charcoal, Wood Oil, and Wood using a simple tree farm.

For a more in-depth explanation, I recommend you watch this video:
[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PtRj-dLJcMo[/url]

e2b76018acb04b65-9cc9512a10571971-acb0-4.name: Charging Station
e2b76018acb04b65-9cc9512a10571971-acb0-4.desc:
The §6Charging Station§r is a singleblock machine that automatically charges §6electrical§r items, such as§c Power Armor§r or §dPower Tools §r(if held) while you stand in front of it.

It is able to be crafted in §ebulk§r, and thus deemed practical to place at different doorways in your base. This helps keeps your armor fully charged.

c2c207bb69384a8e-842485d8b58e2f67-6938-4.name: Charm of Protection
c2c207bb69384a8e-842485d8b58e2f67-6938-4.desc: This should be your first §6Armor Mod§r. The §bCharm of Protection§r prevents§d meteors§r from destroying blocks, which is a utility best acquired in early game to save yourself from meteors§c destroying§r your machines.

68a7804eef0c43ae-8136894d591b4b3e-ef0c-4.name: Chemical Plant
68a7804eef0c43ae-8136894d591b4b3e-ef0c-4.desc:
The §6Chemical Plant§r is an electrical machine used for various chemistry-related processes. Like the §6[quest]Assembly Machine[/quest]§r, you have to select the recipe from within the UI.

The §6Chemical Plant§r accepts fluids and items from any side and outputs to any side, having many ports. It has §93§r fluid inputs and§9 3§r item inputs.

It also is able to use §9Blueprints§r, which can help unlock some specific recipes.

&qFun Fact§r: The model is visibly inspired from §6Factorio§r. It is also commonly abbreviated to "§6Chemplant§r" in the NTM Community.

0e7769d1cbd14e91-b769b9e722921dd8-cbd1-4.name: Cobaltite
0e7769d1cbd14e91-b769b9e722921dd8-cbd1-4.desc: §6Cobaltite§r is your main source of §6Cobalt§r. You find it in the Nether in large seams, mining it without silk touch yields Cobalt Fragments, but with Silk Touch, it yields the block itself, usable in the [quest]Crucible[/quest].

ccafffb79f7f4141-8b34d78c7e52dfac-9f7f-4.name: Color Tool
ccafffb79f7f4141-8b34d78c7e52dfac-9f7f-4.desc:
The §6Color Tool§r is a tool from my mod, &qColorwheel§r, which lets you color any block any color!

Check its§a tooltip §rfor more information on how to use it.

e43abaf05c44429a-872505ad38b51eac-5c44-4.name: Combination Oven
e43abaf05c44429a-872505ad38b51eac-5c44-4.desc:
The §6Combination Oven§r is a heat-based machine that can perform unique smelting recipes, providing an extra fluid output alongside.

Some important recipes include §9Coke§r, which makes Coal much more efficient for use as a fuel, and §eCharcoal§r, which can later be used to automate the Automatic Buzz Saw's operations.

&qFun Fact§r: This machine is often called the§6 Comboven §ror the §6Combo Oven §rfor short.

7c58a8d53ee5483e-9e4de9409e1ec06e-3ee5-4.name: Compressor
7c58a8d53ee5483e-9e4de9409e1ec06e-3ee5-4.desc:
The §6Compressor§r is an electrical machine that§6 Pressurizes§r fluids. It applies a level of§e PU §r(Pressure Units) to the fluid inputted, and may also change the fluid being processed (Perfluoromethyl, for example).

Pressurized fluids are used in some recipes, like in the§6 Vaccuum Distillery§r. They§c cannot §rbe stored in tanks, and travel in the same pipes as their parent fluids.

4bb2e4f923854e0c-ae7f3343928145f8-2385-4.name: Converters
4bb2e4f923854e0c-ae7f3343928145f8-2385-4.desc:
§eConverters§r are singleblock machines that convert§c NTM's §rpower units§r §9§r(HE)§r§r i§rnto other mods' power units, like RF, and vice versa.

It is required for use of§a OpenComputers§r and§9 Applied Energistics§r in this modpack.

It has a large energy buffer inside it, which means you should limit throughput to it to avoid draining your power grid. This can be achieved with a§c Red Copper Diode§r.

Here, have one. You deserve it.

e8588e11419a4884-a4ff2c1b4a014ab4-419a-4.name: Conveyors
e8588e11419a4884-a4ff2c1b4a014ab4-419a-4.desc:
§6Conveyors §rare a cheap logistics method in NTM, which allow you to move around items on conveyor belts.

To place them, you can simply§b right click §rand follow the ghost outline of the conveyor. If you wanna place them manually you can shift click, and you can change their direction using a [quest]Screwdriver[/quest].

Conveyors §ccannot§r interface with inventories directly, and as such need a few separate blocks to interact with them:

§6Conveyor Inserters§r allow you to insert items into an inventory from a conveyor. The conveyor needs to be facing into the inserter in order to feed it. Inserters also void items if they're full by default, which may cause wastage of items.

§bConveyor Ejectors§r allow you to take items out of inventories to a conveyor. The conveyor does not need to face into our out of the ejector, it can be parallel to it. Ejectors can also be configured with various upgrades (Ejection Speed and Stack upgrades) and they can also use filters.

§9Conveyor Grabbers§r allow you to "grab" items off of conveyor belts running parallel to them, placing them in inventories. They can accept filters, and upgrades, as they only grab a certain amount of items and may miss some items if the conveyor is too full. They also can ignore items if the inventory they are inserting into is full. They do not have their own inventories, and they can grab from any direction.

§aConveyor Boxers/Unboxers§r allow you to package large amounts of items in boxes, and then unbox them back into items. 

§3Conveyor Sorters§r allow you to sort items into different directions based on various criteria.

§eConveyor Splitters§r allow you to split a single belt into two different belts, you can modify the ratio by right-clicking the respective side with a §6[quest]Screwdriver[/quest].§r

Conveyors can move up and down by default.

NOTE: Having too many items on a conveyor causes it to explode.

Conveyors also have §dmulti-lane§r variants, which have multiple tracks, and §2Express §rvariants, which move way faster.

&qFun Fact§r: Before, conveyor chutes and ramps used to be items you'd have to craft. Newgen NTM players should rejoice that this isn't as hard anymore!

0d03320ac28a4ddc-89198533b47f7ed5-c28a-4.name: Crates
0d03320ac28a4ddc-89198533b47f7ed5-c28a-4.desc:
§bCrates§r are essentially portable chests. They can be§3 picked up§r, retaining contents, and they can be §bright clicked§r while held to open their inventory.

You can also put crates in §6other crates§r, but abusing this excessively may cause you to get §4chunk-banne§r§4d§r or cause issues with your client.

Note that crates preserve the radiation of items inside them, so storing your radioactive items in a crate won't do anything.

Crates are commonly found in structures, make sure to loot them for free storage.

61689db5e8d144a7-8e32515878660443-e8d1-4.name: Crowbar
61689db5e8d144a7-8e32515878660443-e8d1-4.desc: The §dCrowbar§r is a hand tool used for opening [quest]Crates[/quest]. You find crates in structures, but to open them you will need a crowbar.

c27f52137f9f438d-9aacf59d0cf090af-7f9f-4.name: Crucible
c27f52137f9f438d-9aacf59d0cf090af-7f9f-4.desc:
The §6Crucible§r is an important machine as it is the central component of metallurgy in NTM. It is used as a method of §eore processing§r,§9 alloying§r (of which some are either more efficient or specific to this machine), and§c metal casting§r. It requires an external heat source to melt the inputs into liquids and when filled, it emits a consistent amount of soot that can cause a fair amount of pollution that cannot be mitigated.

The machine requires heat to operate, which can be provided by placing it on top of any heat generating machine. It will operate as long as it has at least§c 50,000TU§r provided to it.

The crucible has two outlets, a green recipe side, where metals that are valid for the recipe will end up and mix, and a red waste side, where other metals will collect. If no recipe is set, all materials will flow into the green side.

The crucible utilizes a special §c§bmolten fluid syste§r§bm§r §rthat uses various item based units.
The units are:

§eBlock§r§es§r, equivalent to one block of a resource, equivalent to 9 Ingots
§eIngot§r§es§r, equivalent to one ingot item of a resource, equivalent to 9 Nuggets
§eNugget§r§es§r, equivalent to one nugget item of a resource or a tiny pile of powder, equivalent to 8 Quanta
§eQuanta§r,§r§r the smallest unit which cannot be divided.
The word §eQuantu§r§em§r is a singular version of the plural word Quanta.

Foundry scraps can be retrieved from any§6 foundry block§r or the §7crucible§r itself by using a shovel on them. This scrap can be used to §cfilter§r foundry outlets to only allow certain materials to flow. This scrap can also be remelted in the crucible to return it to a usable state.

7b75743fc99f4fc8-a0a6812a5a7d4c4d-c99f-4.name: Decoration Blocks
7b75743fc99f4fc8-a0a6812a5a7d4c4d-c99f-4.desc:
NTM has a variety of §5decoration block§r§5s§r to help you decorate your base. Some of these are;

§6Deco Blocks§r, which come for all major materials (§aTungsten, Red Copper, Steel§r) and provide a cheap and easy way to create §escaffolding§r for your base or act as a nice industrial block in general. It's a §9CT§r block, meaning placing multiple next to one another causes their textures to connect together. They can be found in structures and also §arecycled§r for a bit of extra ingots.

§bPlatemetal§r, which is a cheap and smooth looking decorative block with nice walking sounds, made with just§7 Iron Plates§r. It's also colorable, and a §9CT§r block just like the deco blocks.

There are also §6Scaffolding§r,§b Poles§r, §cBeams§r, and§9 Roofs§r, all with models, being good for details. They're also rotatable so you can use them in a variety of situations.

&qFun Fact§r: Platemetal was my (iris-lgtm's, so the author of this pack and questbook!) first addition to NTM, and it was PR'ed to NTMMain. I'm surprised it got accepted!

392854218fd24c4b-913f4ee97fd93ec2-8fd2-4.name: Dense Wire
392854218fd24c4b-913f4ee97fd93ec2-8fd2-4.desc:
Casting §6Dense Wire§r is a common thing most NTM players do after they create their first one. Dense wire takes a lot of§e §f§eHE§r§r §rto make and often overloads power grids, so a recommended course of action is making a Mold of that Dense Wire and casting dense wire into that.

§6Dense wire§r is only an ingot; so you can also craft §e9x§r Dense wire at once using a regular Basin mold.

9b4a937d57cb4679-84e4e9b2333e1e80-57cb-4.name: Drainage Pipe
9b4a937d57cb4679-84e4e9b2333e1e80-57cb-4.desc:
The §6Drainage Pipe §ris a special kind of pipe that allows you to disperse fluids into the atmosphere.

Fluid pollution stats apply when dispersing. It has a throughput of §e1000mb/t§r.

65267f41ca124555-aa82f662aa2dc544-ca12-4.name: Electricity and Cables
65267f41ca124555-aa82f662aa2dc544-ca12-4.desc: Electricity in NTM works off of a power unit called §7HE.§r HE has §6unlimited§r throughput, similar to fluids. It can be transported via cables, painted cables, pylons, etc.

38383f4853d94e35-adfac712ecdeed42-53d9-4.name: Exploration & Extra Quests
38383f4853d94e35-adfac712ecdeed42-53d9-4.desc: Next Quests are for§6 Exploration§r and extra tidbits about the mod.

d36864d7b06349a0-bd5384e530dd0272-b063-4.name: Firebrick
d36864d7b06349a0-bd5384e530dd0272-b063-4.desc: §6Firebricks §rare an important early resource that are used in a lot of machines, heating applications, and most importantly the §b[quest]Crucible[/quest]§r and §4[quest]Heating Oven[/quest]§r. However it is also used later in the game too, so making a stack or two is always a good idea.

1f0715bc8c8345a1-8fd02d106525da63-8c83-4.name: Fluid Identification
1f0715bc8c8345a1-8fd02d106525da63-8c83-4.desc:
NTM, unlike other tech mods, has a special fluid system of its own. This fluid system has a few core principles:

1) Fluids need to be §6assigned §rto containers, pipes, and machines. What this means is that a fluid cannot automatically enter a pipe network or a container, the container needs to be §6ASSIGNED§r to the respective fluid before it can enter the tank.

2) Fluid pipes of any kind have §6no throughput limit§f and can pass fluid between them instantaneously. §6

NOTE§r: Tanks may have a throughput limit, but it scales on how much fluid is inside them.

To assign fluids, you'll need the§b Fluid Identifier§r.§6 Sneak right click§r to assign a fluid to a tank (or place it in the identifier slot) And§6 right click§r it to customize which fluid it is currently able to assign.&q

Fun Fact§r: In older versions of NTM you had to craft each individual fluid ID.. yikes.

920239a73e404fae-90a6653a4af7e9f5-3e40-4.name: Foundry Basins
920239a73e404fae-90a6653a4af7e9f5-3e40-4.desc:
In order to cast the molten material created inside the material, various blocks are used to route the molten material into molds. These are called §6Basins§r.

The molds themselves are shaped in an §6[quest]Iron Anvil[/quest]§r using the two§a§r combination§r §rslots available in the top of the anvil GUI. 

There are three types of Basins:

§6Shallow foundry basins§r, which receive molten material from channels, either from above via an outlet, or directly from the sides. The foundry basin must be fitted with a mold before it can receive material. Once it has filled up with enough material to satisfy the current mold, it will begin cooling. Hoppers and conveyors can be attached to both basin types to pull the finished products from them, otherwise they must be right-clicked to extract the finished products, and won't accept any more material until they have been emptied. 

§6Foundry basins§r, which receive molten material from channels, filling up material. Once enough material has flowed into the basin, it will begin cooling the material. Foundry basins require molds to be inserted to function, otherwise they will not receive material. Unlike the shallow foundry basins, they will not receive material from their sides, and must be poured into from above with an outlet. 

§6Foundry storage basins§r, which receive molten metal but do not cast them. Instead they're used for storage of these molten metals for later use. 

Note that you can sneak right click on a §6Basin§r block with a [quest]TNbsCfffRleDE0FQnamOxQ==[/quest] to extract the mold from it.

cb7e7c51fb4b4aa2-a979537d9c3a561d-fb4b-4.name: Foundry Channels
cb7e7c51fb4b4aa2-a979537d9c3a561d-fb4b-4.desc:
§6Foundry Channels §rare blocks that allow molten materials to be poured into them from either Foundry Outlets or metallurgy-based machines, like the [quest]Crucible[/quest] and Electrolyser.

Foundry channels can only hold one type of metal at a time, Right-Clicking one of these blocks with a shovel will output a Scrap item of whatever material was inside the channel at the time.


Besides that, there are also §cOutlets§r, which output molten material. These come in two types:

§6Foundry outlets§r, which are used to drop material down to lower foundry channels, into foundry basins, or into storage basins. These outlets can be disabled with a redstone signal, and by right-clicking on them that behavior can be inverted (needs redstone to be enabled). They can also be filtered to only drain certain materials by using foundry scraps of the given material, and said filter can be cleared with a [quest]Screwdriver[/quest] or turned into a blacklist with a hand drill (both actions require a sneak+right-click).

§6Foundry spill outlets§r, which are almost identical to foundry outlets, except that they can also be placed over empty space, allowing slag and other waste products to be spilled into the world without the need for a basin. Spilled materials are not hot and will expand if large enough, unless they are surrounded from all sides by other blocks.

0332438b4fa04642-bca011a68b032d64-4fa0-4.name: Free Cursor Mode
0332438b4fa04642-bca011a68b032d64-4fa0-4.desc: Pressing§6 Ctrl §ron your keyboard while in-game allows you to defocus your cursor from your screen. This allows you to hover over machines and pipe networks to inspect them from long distances, and also interact with various on-screen UIs, like the §eInfotab§r and §eJetpack §rfor example.

3ac62b48b4914ccc-83aa3b124442a556-b491-4.name: Genesis
3ac62b48b4914ccc-83aa3b124442a556-b491-4.desc:
Welcome to §6NTM: IQ Edition.§r This questline will guide you through the progression of the mod.

To start, This questline assumes you have already done the basic Minecraft things, like making a crafting table, pickaxe, trees, etc.

§bSubmit 16 Cobblestone to confirm you've done it already.§r

d6f70d722eb04c74-893a4f8ce7f80f37-2eb0-4.name: Gliding
d6f70d722eb04c74-893a4f8ce7f80f37-2eb0-4.desc: The§6 Hang Glider §ris an item from §cOpenBlocks§r which allows you to glide in the air. §bRight click §rto open the glider and glide mid-air.

45209c5a05d4474a-af33e772ae204ac9-05d4-4.name: Glyphids
45209c5a05d4474a-af33e772ae204ac9-05d4-4.desc:
You will notice hives strewn across your world, containing a deadly invasive alien species called §9Glyphids§r. 

If you've played factorio, glyphids get stronger over time and based on how much pollution there is in the environment, evolving into new variants, and if you're on rampage mode, they can even spread using scouts!

Glyphids also have cousins in the§4 nether§r, follow the Nether questline for information on those.

1608f0e6e8874166-9e225973aedf4938-e887-4.name: Heating Oven
1608f0e6e8874166-9e225973aedf4938-e887-4.desc:
The§6 Heating Oven§r, §9Firebox§r, §aFluid Burner §rand §bElectric Heater§r are a set of Heat Providing §rblocks, that, when placed underneath certain Heat-Requiring machines, will power them with Heat, i.e §bTU§r. TU is explained better in the quest, [quest]Hot Hot Hot![/quest].

The§9 §6Firebox§r§r and §6Heating Oven§r are the solid fuel providers.


The§6 Firebox§r burns fuels with full efficiency, but much slower.

The§r §c§6Heating Oven§r §rburns fuel for §45x§r as much heat but§e §6§e8x§r§r§r less duration.
§r
Heating Ovens can also be stacked on top of each other to compound their heat outputs, but their heat output is cut in half when doing this.

The §c§aFluid Burner§r§r and§e §bElectric Heater§r §ruse §d§fFluids§r§r (like Wood Oil, Heating Oil) and§b HE§r respectively, and their Heat throughput can be adjusted with a §c[quest]Screwdriver[/quest]§r.

[warn]NOTE:[/warn] The Electric Heater is not unlocked until much later in progression.

01473fe4f9464d32-bd0ba53873581b98-f946-4.name: Hematite
01473fe4f9464d32-bd0ba53873581b98-f946-4.desc: §6Hematite §ris a resource you can find in abundance in the Overworld. It can be processed in a [quest]Crucible[/quest] to provide Iron and Slag. To process it, you will need Flux.

32e20b7a0ee84329-af6dd20dd466f109-0ee8-4.name: High-Speed Steel
32e20b7a0ee84329-af6dd20dd466f109-0ee8-4.desc:
§9High-Speed Steel§r is a variant of Regular steel that is produced in the [quest]Crucible[/quest] with §bCobalt§r and§7 Tungsten§r, alongside regular steel.

It's used in a few key recipes, like the Centrifuge Element and for the Industrial Mixer. It is also used for various weapon and tool upgrades, such as for the Drill, and as gun parts.

&qFun Fact§r: This type of steel is called Dura-Steel in the source code.

ef234b856ba54250-a26fee6a2d48fa65-6ba5-4.name: Hot Hot Hot!
ef234b856ba54250-a26fee6a2d48fa65-6ba5-4.desc:
Heat in NTM is measured in §6TU§r, or §6Thermal Units§r. Heat is used by a few select machines and appears in a few key locations, you might notice it being mentioned in the previous quest for "§9Heat Providing§r" Machines.

Heat can be generated via various machines, those being §rthe§6 Firebox§r, §6Heating Ove§r§6n§r, §6Fluid Burner§r and §6Electric Heater§r.
§r§r
Besides that, there is also the§9 Heat Exchanging Heater§r, which uses a fluid and cools it down, thereby removing the heat from it.

The §eGeothermal Heat Exchanger§r also exists, allowing you to place it above a pool of §6Lava§r or §cGeothermal Vent§r§cs§r to generate Heat - However this heat is only used to heat fluids, not able to be extracted for any other purpose.

Heat is provided from the top of the Heat Providers, to the bottom of the Heat Requiring machines. You can stack multiple providers ontop of each other, but it §chalves§r the added heat when you do this transfer.

Heat is used in various machines, such as the §e[quest]Stirling Engines[/quest]§r, §e§f §r§e[quest]Boiler[/quest]§r§r§e§r, §e[quest]Stirling Sawmill[/quest]§r, §r§eCoker Unit§r, §eCombination Furnace§r, §e[quest]Crucible[/quest]§r, and §e[quest]Steel Furnace[/quest]§r.§r

Stirling Machines also have §cHeavy§r Variants, as some regular Stirling machines aren't able to handle high heat levels, and thus require you to craft a Heavy variant which can handle the higher Heat.

Different fluids can also be§ §c burned §r§rfor Heat, mostly in the §6Fluid Burner§r. Their Heat production per bucket is written in their tooltip.

01f93f7585d64ac5-8115fe1b60d1a88d-85d6-4.name: Industrial Mixer
01f93f7585d64ac5-8115fe1b60d1a88d-85d6-4.desc:
The§b Industrial Mixer§r is an electrical machine that allows you to mix fluids and items together. It has 2 tanks and 1 item slot for input, and 1 tank for fluid output.

Its recipe can be changed by putting a§6 Fluid Identifier §rin the output slot. It also has a separate button on the top, allowing you to choose between multiple methods of producing the same output.

Some of these are:

§6Fracking Solution§r, where it has one with water, petroleum gas and sulfur and another one with sulfuric acid and petroleum gas§r.

§6Biofue§r§6l§r, where it has recipes with wood oil and fish oil and another one with wood oil and sunflower seed oil.

§6Nitroglyceri§r§6n§r, where it has recipes with nitric acid and petroleum gas and another one with nitric acid and fish oil.

§6Oxyhydroge§r§6n§r, where it has recipes with liquid hydrogen with liquid oxygen and another one with just liquid hydrogen.

§6Engine Lubrican§r§6t§r, where it has recipes with ethanol and sunflower seed oil; ethanol with fish oil; and heating oil with unsaturated hydrocarbons.

§6Solven§r§6t§r, where it has recipes with aromatic hydrocarbons and each of the 4 types of naphtha.§r§r§r

7ecb4da70e054fb4-aac06061be3c142e-0e05-4.name: Infotab
7ecb4da70e054fb4-aac06061be3c142e-0e05-4.desc:
The §eInfotab§r is an armor piece/armor mod (You can apply it later, using the Armor Modification Table) that provides an overlay on your screen, showing you what block you're looking at.

You can also press §6Ctrl§r to unfocus your cursor, and be able to click the display. Right clicking it opens the uses of the block being looked at, and left click opens the recipes for the block being looked at.

15dd90077881401d-b407967408be5778-7881-4.name: Insulator Automation
15dd90077881401d-b407967408be5778-7881-4.desc:
§bHemp §rcan be used to automate§6 Insulators§r for future use.

By processing Hemp into Ethanol, you can infinitely feed your §6[quest]Automatic Thresher[/quest]§r with Ethanol as fuel, and by using §6Conveyor Grabbers§f on the same conveyor you have your Hemp on, you can make sure it's limited such that it won't take more than necessary.§r

This leaves a surplus of hemp, and you can craft it into String using§6 Automatic Crafting Tables§r.§r§r Using a §eConveyor Splitter§r, you can divide this string, with one of the split belts producing Wool. At the end, you can combine the two to produce §dinfinite§r Insulators.

7c1fff9125b34a5e-a59b45854d216406-25b3-4.name: Iron Anvil
7c1fff9125b34a5e-a59b45854d216406-25b3-4.desc:
Anvils are one of the basic crafting stations in NTM. They allow you to do various recipes, including:

§bCombination recipes,§r in the top two slots. This is for creating molds, and other smithing-related recipes, like chainsteel and meteorite ingots.

§6Crafting recipes,§r which take items directly from your inventory. They also can recycle items into other items, like crushing rare earth into rare earth metal fragments for instance, or recycling deco blocks into Ingots.

Anvils also have tiers, you need to make the next tier of Anvil in order to progress.

b936bc3af22a4da8-86a427967fd32398-f22a-4.name: Limestone
b936bc3af22a4da8-86a427967fd32398-f22a-4.desc:
§6Limestone§r is a decently rare resource found in the Overworld, and it's used in a wide variety of recipes. Currently, you can use it for producing more and more Firebrick, but later on you can Shred it in a [quest]Shredder[/quest] to produce §aLimestone Dust§r, which can further be used for Flux, which is incredibly important for the §e[quest]Crucible[/quest]§e.

§rAlthough you can make Flux via other methods, like §6Charcoal§r, for now this is the most efficient way.§r

d7cdba83299a4fcc-a8d6cb7d44965ea2-299a-4.name: Long Distance Energy Transport
d7cdba83299a4fcc-a8d6cb7d44965ea2-299a-4.desc:
Once you begin expanding your factory, you will discover you need §6Oil§r. §6Oil§r is tied to a specific location, being Oil Deposits, and you have to provide resources from your base to that specific location. That is where the Large Pylons come in.

For transporting §9Electricity§r over long distances, basic Pylons may be inefficient; Hence, you should use the Upgraded form of basic Energy Pylons, which are§6 Substations§r and §6Large Pylons§r.

§6Substations §rare placed on the ground next to cables, and powering them lets you connect them using a§6 Cable Drum§r to a §6Large Pylon§r, which has much further range than basic pylons. You also need another §6Substation§r to receive the energy and route cables out to your machines.

0a79511e11084764-a3e1757bb01b8338-1108-4.name: Malachite
0a79511e11084764-a3e1757bb01b8338-1108-4.desc:
§aMalachite§r is a resource found in abundance on §6Earth§r. Mining it without Silk Touch results in Malachite Chunks, which in turn can be used to produce a mass quantity of Copper.

However, using Silk Touch on Malachite will yield the block itself, which is far more efficient and outputs much more copper than the Chunk equivalent.

ecd6e8bfcc2d4c30-9a243c1ac4ae0da3-cc2d-4.name: Mass Glass
ecd6e8bfcc2d4c30-9a243c1ac4ae0da3-cc2d-4.desc:
Glass production can be done on a large scale using §6Molten Glass§r.

Combining §6Hot Sand§r and §aSodium §rin a [quest]Crucible[/quest] will yield Glass, and as each block of sand yields an entire block's worth of Hot Sand, that leads to 1 Sand being able to make 9 full Glass Blocks!

Adding Flux to this recipe makes it even more efficient by doubling the glass output.

03366cbe9dd744b1-8912b809949ec7f2-9dd7-4.name: Mass Storage Units
03366cbe9dd744b1-8912b809949ec7f2-9dd7-4.desc:
§9Mass Storage Units§r are essentially NTM's§6 Storage Drawer§r§6s§r; They are capable of storing 
a§b large quantity§r of§c one type of item§r inside them. They have§a 3 slots:§r §6Top slot§r is for insertion, and, similar to fluids, the§6 middle slot§r contains what type of item is actually being stored. You need to place your item in the middle slot, and then it locks your storage to that item only.

The§c bottom slot§r is an output, you can also set it to §eauto-output§r such that the bottom slot is always topped up with a stack of the respective item.

§6It retains its contents when broken!§r

aedd42e474b94ea6-ad6505d47c6ff513-74b9-4.name: Meteorites
aedd42e474b94ea6-ad6505d47c6ff513-74b9-4.desc:
If you explore or stay in one spot for too long, you will notice a§6 meteorite§r falling from the sky. Meteorites, when fallen, contain various treasures inside them, like special ore, ore crystals, treasure blocks, etc.

They are a good source of §9cobalt§r pre-nether. Also, they may provide resources like Desh, and they are also the primary source of§b Meteorite Powder§r, from which you can forge some pretty awesome tools.

a3c0b9c872bf43e9-bbc4d17673551d46-72bf-4.name: Molds
a3c0b9c872bf43e9-bbc4d17673551d46-72bf-4.desc:
§eMolds§r are items used to cast liquid materials into resources inside of Basins.

§eMolds§r can be made by combining a blank mold with its respective mold item (For example, for a plate mold you will use an Iron Plate) in the top two§b combination§r slots of an [quest]Iron Anvil[/quest].

§eMolds §rcan come in two types, one being used in the §6Shallow [quest]Foundry Basins[/quest]§r,§r processing only one item at a time, and the other being used in the normal §6[quest]Foundry Basins[/quest]§r, processing up to a block's worth of resources at a time.

fb613f5a243b45c8-878692e9d91eda87-243b-4.name: Oil Shales
fb613f5a243b45c8-878692e9d91eda87-243b-4.desc:
§6Oil Shales§r are underground deposits of §6Oil§r, from which§6 Oil§r can be extracted. To actually extract fluid from them, however, you will need a Derrick. Mining them will lead them to drop Tar, which can still be used as §8Black Dye§r.

You can spot them from the surface via spots of §6Cracked Stone§r, which have an§6 Oil Spill §rsurrounding them. These usually point towards an Oil deposit directly underneath them.

Otherwise you can use the §9Reservoir Detector§r.§r Now, since i'm nice, I'll give you one for free.

b3e2e6fec19e462f-9e980831f1b4fb36-c19e-4.name: Plating it Up
b3e2e6fec19e462f-9e980831f1b4fb36-c19e-4.desc:
Now that you have some §7Steel§r, it's time to press atleast 1 stack into plates... If you do so, i'll give you a handsome reward!

This practice of crafting seemingly unneeded components in bulk is called§6 Batch Crafting§r, and it saves a lot of running around later on, cause you will find you already have everything you need.

d68bcea0d33a4126-b506aad2c0c7833d-d33a-4.name: Pollution
d68bcea0d33a4126-b506aad2c0c7833d-d33a-4.desc:
§6Pollution§r is a mechanic that applies to a few polluting machines (like Flare Stacks, Combination Ovens, etc.) or things that generally §6burn§r fuel, or produce smoke.

It comes in 3 main types, being:

§7Soot,§r which is the most common, produced by burning fuels. It increases§c mob strength§r and causes §6Smog§r.
§a
Poison, §rwhich causes damage to entities, and is caused by spilling various fluids.

§6Heavy Metal,§r which comes from leaded fuels. It increases §cmob strength§r.

Pollution is easily manageable via the§a Smokestack§r, read more about the Smokestack in the previous quest, [quest]Smokestack[/quest]. 

§9Pollution§r, besides causing a few negative effects, can also cause §aglyphids§r to evolve, which can be dangerous if not managed properly. You can detect the level of pollution in your vicinity using a§9 Pollution Detector§r.

In the §cNether§r, this is even worse, as §4Nether Glyphids§r are much more dangerous than their overworld counterparts and a lot harder to weed out given the biome they spawn in. That, coupled with the fact that Pollution is§c DOUBLED§r in the Nether, will cause§b §csevere §r§rproblems if you are too reckless!

75aac64ce45c4967-abca8cd617c1902d-e45c-4.name: Powering the Arc Welder
75aac64ce45c4967-abca8cd617c1902d-e45c-4.desc:
The §6[quest]Arc Welder[/quest]§r consumes an immense amount of electricity for even basic recipes, so it is recommended to have energy storage in the form of §6[quest]Battery Sockets[/quest] §rby this point.

This quest also rewards you with a §eGold Capacitor§r so you can get started.

d98af6231a7746b9-87f17c24f52b12a8-1a77-4.name: Pylons
d98af6231a7746b9-87f17c24f52b12a8-1a77-4.desc:
§9Pylons§r and §aConnectors§r are a special type of cable that can be connected via a §9Cable Drum.§r They work exactly the same to cables but are generally more efficient cause you can connect them from a longer range, wasting less cables.

They come in various styles, and can have multiple connections depending on what type of pylon it is. 

§6Connectors §rare just the shorter-range singleblock variants of the pylons, letting you connect them directly.


&qFun Fact§r: A PR by§9 Vitya§r (also known as&#3B2000 Shitya§r) deleted all of the old pylons in many worlds.. Maybe it happened to you, too?

7225f9cdebfa4344-a08bf98ad103d8c1-ebfa-4.name: Raw Ores
7225f9cdebfa4344-a08bf98ad103d8c1-ebfa-4.desc: Some ores are able to drop §6Raw Ores§r. They're functionally the same to regular ores, however these are able to be compacted into 3x3 blocks for storage, and also,§d Fortune §rcan be applied on ore blocks to get many raw ores out of one ore block.

be7a2fed9bc142d7-a2582b37b6c85b1b-9bc1-4.name: Red Copper
be7a2fed9bc142d7-a2582b37b6c85b1b-9bc1-4.desc:
Made in the Blast Furnace, §6Red Copper§r is an alloy of §cRedstone§r and §eCopper§r, which can be pressed into §bwires§r for most electrical applications in the mod. It's also used for coils, dense cables, motors, etc.

&qFun Fact§r: It is interchangeably called Red Copper or Minecraft-Grade Copper, but they're the same thing.

8e2f876bdbae42fc-abec10016ff0e675-dbae-4.name: Rotary Furnace
8e2f876bdbae42fc-abec10016ff0e675-dbae-4.desc:
The§6 Rotary Furnace§r is a machine that allows you to alloy certain metals. It requires §6Solid Fuel§r (like Coal) and§7 Steam§r to work. It produces liquid materials, which need to be cast in a §6Basin§r with a Mold.

It also has 3 item input slots, each of them are §9color-coded§r to the different inventory slots that it has.

4cd6ec09f7df4657-831341509da98ec5-f7df-4.name: Screwdriver
4cd6ec09f7df4657-831341509da98ec5-f7df-4.desc:
The§a Screwdriver§r is a general hand tool used for configuring various machines, usually it is used by shift clicking or right clicking on a machine.

It can also be used on a locked safe found in structures with a §6Bobby Pin§r to lockpick the safes, allowing you to access §arare loot.§r

Later on you can make a §cDesh§r screwdriver, which is unbreakable.

9c7fc42c907142df-a7f44c2b7de019ee-9071-4.name: Settings Tool
9c7fc42c907142df-a7f44c2b7de019ee-9071-4.desc: This tool allows you to copy certain properties inside of machines, like their §9Fluid IDs§r or Settings. §6Sneak Right-Clicking§r copies a setting to them, and right clicking applies the setting to the block being interacted with.

e337bf6ffd53413d-a0211339e08b3f6e-fd53-4.name: Shredder
e337bf6ffd53413d-a0211339e08b3f6e-fd53-4.desc:
The §6Shredder§r is a singleblock machine which can process up to 9 items at once, shredding them into powders or dusts.

It requires §6Blades§r, which can be crafted or cast, and depending on which type of blade will have different durability. §cDesh§r blades never break. 

You can also process up to§d 9 §ritems in parallel, by spreading the items all across the shredder's input evenly. 

It is useful for creating §6Limestone Dust§r, and it can also provide a quick method for doubling ores.

Putting any §6random§r item in it turns that item into Dust, so be careful!

320b752b3f854adf-aa17b608b4fd7a3f-3f85-4.name: Smokestack
320b752b3f854adf-aa17b608b4fd7a3f-3f85-4.desc:
The §6Smokestack§r is a machine whose ports can be connected to various§9 polluting§r machines to reduce the amount of pollution they produce. You do this connection via §bExhaust Pipes§r, which are specialised tubing specifically for this purpose. 

The base§r Smokestack also outputs §aFly Ash§r every so often, and the §4Industrial §rversion outputs§d Fine Soot§r. Fine Soot is something you'll want to stockpile, it's quite important later in the game.

Polluting machines have tooltips showing how much they pollute, and certain fuels also pollute too. See Quest: [quest]Pollution[/quest] for a deeper dive.

ce3692817d7d4c3d-b27ddaf2906a5a8d-7d7d-4.name: Solar Tower Boiler
ce3692817d7d4c3d-b27ddaf2906a5a8d-7d7d-4.desc:
The §6Solar Tower Boiler§r is a steam-generating machine that uses the power of the Sun to boil steam passively during the day. It only has two slots, one for input and one for output. It can only heat Water into Steam.

First, place §6Heliostat Mirrors§r around the Boiler in valid areas such that they are not too close to the Boiler. Place the Boiler high up, around §b6-§r§b8§r blocks. The maximum range is up to 100 blocks.

Then, use a §9Mirror Adjustment Tool§r, by Sneak Right-Clicking the Boiler and Right-Clicking each of the Heliostat Mirrors. This links the Mirrors to the Boiler, allowing them to reflect light towards the Boiler and thus heat it.

The boiler consumes §7§61 mB§r§r of water for every §612.5 §rmirrors each tick at full sunlight level, and §6100 mB§r of steam per mB of water consumed. 

The amount of Steam generated §cdiminishes§r during noon and§4 stops completely§r during nighttime or if it is raining. Thus, it is recommended to use a §6[quest]Battery Sockets[/quest]§r to provide backup energy during the night.

You can calculate the amount of §6Steam§r generated by an N amount of Mirrors at the §cNTM wiki§r, here:

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Solar_Tower_Boiler[/url]

08033f081ce14663-976ef79b020d24f9-1ce1-4.name: Soldering Station
08033f081ce14663-976ef79b020d24f9-1ce1-4.desc:
The §6Soldering Station§r is an electrical machine used primarily for soldering electronic components, like Circuit Boards and Upgrades.

It can also accept §bfluids§r for use in later recipes, and the button for recipe collision prevention essentially just stops no-fluid recipes like the §6Integrated Circuit§r§6 Board§r from running when there's a recipe that uses the inputted fluid.

7e1055487f534473-8b9135625a597b71-7f53-4.name: Steam  Condenser
7e1055487f534473-8b9135625a597b71-7f53-4.desc:
The§6 Steam Condenser§r is a singleblock machine that is able to turn§9 Low-Pressure Steam §rback into Water.

This is helpful for creating §6Closed§r loops for Steam, as you can then recycle the §9Low-Pressure Stea§r§9m§r into Water. Nearly all machines that use Steam, like the [quest]Rotary Furnace[/quest], Steam Turbines, Cracking Tower return Low-Pressure Steam to be recycled. Thus, a Closed-loop cycle is possible for all these machines.

01c3706d1b5e4351-b47fd469160ab9b2-1b5e-4.name: Steam Engine
01c3706d1b5e4351-b47fd469160ab9b2-1b5e-4.desc:
The Steam Engine is a§6 power-generating§r machine that generates energy from §6Steam§r. It also outputs§9 Low-Pressure Steam§r, which you can turn back into Water using a condenser, creating a Closed Loop. 

It converts §9Steam§r into §6Energy§r at an efficiency of 85%, and able to process 2000mB/t of Steam, to generate a peak energy output of §63400HE§r/t or §668KHE§r/s.

9afa472835df4584-ab6d175a737a6ee3-35df-4.name: Steel
9afa472835df4584-ab6d175a737a6ee3-35df-4.desc:
§6Steel§r is quite an important resource in NTM's progression. It's used everywhere from earlygame to lategame, in many different forms; However, your concern with it now should be to keep a §abacklog§r of steel passively smelting as you go about your world.

In early game, you can use the §c[quest]Blast Furnace[/quest]§r, with the recipe of §9Raw Iron §r+§e Flux§r being recommended, as it outputs §93§r Steel Ingots. However, the §c[quest]Crucible[/quest]§r is also an option later on. If you can't make Flux right now, you can always use Sand. Later in the game, Steel can be automated via various methods, like §6[quest]Bedrock Ore Processing[/quest]§r.

72e70ee598314ab5-ae8b29d7a5b4dce8-9831-4.name: Steel Anvil
72e70ee598314ab5-ae8b29d7a5b4dce8-9831-4.desc:
You can upgrade your anvil by putting a regular §6[quest]Iron Anvil[/quest]§r plus the upgrade material of choice in the top two §bcombination§r slots of an Anvil. So yes, you do need two anvils to upgrade it.

Anvil upgrades unlock various §6utility§r recipes as well as being required for some machines, such as the §cSteel Anvil§r being required for machines like the §a[quest]Heating Oven[/quest]§r.

05d41b69e98440c9-a6cea83c33e47d6b-e984-4.name: Steel Furnace
05d41b69e98440c9-a6cea83c33e47d6b-e984-4.desc:
The §6Steel Furnace§r is an advanced furnace that uses §9TU§r (Heat) to smelt items.

It can smelt 3 items at a time, and also gives a §ebonus §rfor smelting§a ores§r and §9wood§r, where every fourth item smelted yields an §aadditional§r item for free.

Smelting more items in the slots causes a rapid increase in heat usage, so you should only use it if you have a suitable heat source.


It has a heat transfer rate of§c ΔT * 0.05 TU/t,§r which means that it can increase its heat beyond the lower limit only by §b§65%§r §revery tick.

7287cbf2a7244b1e-9076ed839f1f46cf-a724-4.name: Stirling Engines
7287cbf2a7244b1e-9076ed839f1f46cf-a724-4.desc:
The §6Stirling Engine§r is a machine that converts §6TU§r into §cHE §rat 50% efficiency. 


Providing it with up to §6300 TU/t§r of Heat can produce up to§c 150 HE/t§r, or §c3 KHE/s§r. However, the base Stirling Engine caps out at this point, and to go further you need to use a §aHeavy§r Stirling Engine§r.§r 

If you let it overspeed, the§r §a§rStirling Engine's§r §r§rwheel will fly off and make everything go to &#2C1800shit§r.

&qFun Fact§r: The word "&#2C1800Shit§r" is a reference to Vitya, as he is often called &#2C1800Shitya §rin the NTM Community.

49e48586e657401c-87be0bff2ecfd0fe-e657-4.name: Stirling Sawmill
49e48586e657401c-87be0bff2ecfd0fe-e657-4.desc:
The §6Stirling Sawmill§r is a Heat-Consuming machine which is used to process§e Wood§r more efficiently.

It has only one variant, and can only handle up to§c 300TU/t§r before§a overspeeding§r and §2exploding§r.

It can produce extra §ePlanks§r from Logs, §cSawdust§r, and§9 Sticks§r.

a96e793129b842e1-94fdf3a956a2c13e-29b8-4.name: Storage and Logistics
a96e793129b842e1-94fdf3a956a2c13e-29b8-4.desc: You will have to store and route many items throughout your playthrough, this quest links to some good ways to do so.

6c2219371fc24f73-9ea01ed5d8f73d97-1fc2-4.name: Strand Caster
6c2219371fc24f73-9ea01ed5d8f73d97-1fc2-4.desc:
The§6 Strand Caster §ris a machine that acts as an upgraded form of a Basin. It can accept molten materials from the wide, funnel-like area on its top side. It also accepts any mold.

It is able to §6instantly§r cast any material, but it consumes Water and outputs Low-Pressure Steam. You can then use a §b[quest]Steam  Condenser[/quest]§r to turn that Low-Pressure Steam back into Water, thus creating a closed loop.

b62b88557e9a4edb-ac74d4d8fc1c63a0-7e9a-4.name: Structures
b62b88557e9a4edb-ac74d4d8fc1c63a0-7e9a-4.desc:
NTM, unlike other tech mods, has a wide array of§9 structures §rfor you to explore, containing loot like§6 guns§r,§c ammo§r, §amachine parts§r, §4circuit parts§r, and even §3nuclear weapons§r.

Structures also have locked safes and hidden loot in them, so be on the lookout for those!

You should also probably get a [quest]Crowbar[/quest], as there are an abundance of §3[quest]Crates[/quest]§r within these structures containing even more loot.

b05dc9c718314769-b224f6e19a65d6b8-1831-4.name: The Nether
b05dc9c718314769-b224f6e19a65d6b8-1831-4.desc: The Nether provides an array of new content, threats, and things to explore. Check it out in the chapter "[quest]Helldivers[/quest]"

fb59795da6fc4d02-9c2d6570f7d448b4-a6fc-4.name: Toolbox
fb59795da6fc4d02-9c2d6570f7d448b4-a6fc-4.desc:
Tired of managing your hotbar? The§6 toolbox§r is a useful tool allowing you to swap your hotbar with a row of items you have in the toolbox. It's extremely useful for having, say, a hotbar for combat, mining, building, etc..

§6Sneak right click§r to open it,§6 right click§r to swap, it swaps by each row in the toolbox's storage.

d1321a49f622419d-aef181e58e783552-f622-4.name: Traveller's Backpacks
d1321a49f622419d-aef181e58e783552-f622-4.desc:
§6Traveller's Backpacks§r are a useful, exploration focused storage method. They come in various skins which have different effects, allowing you to get anything from night vision to fire resistance while wearing them.

Besides the effects, they can also be used for various utilities. They have an inbuilt §aCrafting space,§r§b Fluid storage,§r And a §csleeping bag§r you can take out when necessary. They also have§9 tool storage§r, allowing you to§6 sneak-scroll§r to swap out your tools when necessary.

e1694a6720234076-9feec98473f0266c-2023-4.name: Upgrades
e1694a6720234076-9feec98473f0266c-2023-4.desc:
§dUpgrades§r are items in NTM that can be put into machines to apply various effects to them. These upgrades have different effects for each machine, you can view their individual effects by hovering over them while in the respective machine's §6UI§r.

These upgrades include:

[img height=300]betterquesting:textures/upgrades.png[/img]

2adb0cdbb2e74dea-aa4c3d35e7a6166e-b2e7-4.name: Wood-Burning Generator
2adb0cdbb2e74dea-aa4c3d35e7a6166e-b2e7-4.desc:
The§6 Wood-Burning Generator§r is the earliest generator you can acquire, needing §7Steel§r to craft.

It can be used to smelt §cSolid Fuels§r as well as a variety of §9Liquid Fuels§r, such as Wood Oil. It provides bonuses to certain fuel types, you can see these in its tooltip.

It has an energy output at the back, and requires you to turn it on via the UI's switch before it burns fuel.

cf4532638e9948c1-bebc0fcd55f6d863-8e99-4.name: Extra Mods
cf4532638e9948c1-bebc0fcd55f6d863-8e99-4.desc:
The IQ Edition Official Pack contains many extra mods to help with an average player's progression. Some of these are:

§6FindIt:§r Pressing T in the inventory allows you to locate items in chests.

§6Backhand: §rAllows you to hold an item in your offhand, like Modern MC.

§6Adventure Backpacks:§r Adds backpacks craftable and found in structures and chests, allowing you to store items as well as keep your tools ready.

§6BetterQuesting:§r The mod which allows you to read this questbook! Invite your friends to your quest party (Party in the main menu of the questbook) to share QuestBook progression.[warn] NOTE: This may not work well on LAN servers or E4MC.[/warn]

§6Inventory Sorting:§r Middle click or press the sort button to instantly sort your inventory.
§6
Extreme Sound Muffler:§r Lets you selectively muffle sounds in your surroundings.

§6Gravestone:§r Saves all your items on death as a gravestone.

§6ItemPhysic:§r Makes dropping items a bit more appealing visually and allows you to adjust the throwing distance of your items.

§6Minemoticon:§r Adds emojis to minecraft text!

§6SignPicture:§r Allows you to place urls on signs to load custom images.

§6Schematica:§r Allows you to save, load, and build schematics for building.

§6§6DuraDispla§yy:§f Shows your durability in the hotbar.

5783e687b3254eb4-a44fe69a811972c8-b325-4.name: Modpack Specifics
5783e687b3254eb4-a44fe69a811972c8-b325-4.desc:
These are some important things to remember, as they're specific changes made for this modpack:
§1
§91)§r§r This modpack uses IQ Edition, do not update it manually, as the developers will automatically push an update which will be installed by FileDirector on pack update. Using other NTM Forks might break your world!

§1§92)§r §fUse NEI for recipes, it's always much more convenient than asking people in discord.§r

§1§93)§r§r World generation is handled by Worley's Caves and RTG, although this might be subject to change in the future. The default world type is RTG (Realistic)

§94)§r Angelica might lead textures to go to shit, so be careful.

§95) §rThe modpack can handle LWJGL3ify, if you somehow are without it then you should install it from the instructions here: [url]https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/lwjgl3ify[/url]

46af398723a74c96-abf2d22a0f42d261-23a7-4.name: NEI
46af398723a74c96-abf2d22a0f42d261-23a7-4.desc:
NotEnoughItems is an essential mod that allows you to view recipes and manage recipe bookmarks. Here is some important info about it:

Pressing §6R§r while hovering on an item shows its crafting recipe.

Pressing §6U§r while hovering on an item shows all the recipes that item is used in.

Pressing§6 A§r while hovering on an item will bookmark it to the left of your screen, for future reference.

Pressing §6Control+Shift+A§r will show the ingredients of a specific item's specific recipe in the bookmark section.

Pressing the §61/1§r allows you to format the recipes you have bookmarked.

a3a398f95dc34985-91a29e36a0615fd3-5dc3-4.name: NTM Modes
a3a398f95dc34985-91a29e36a0615fd3-5dc3-4.desc:
NTM Has various modes that change the game, you can enable 'em in the [warn]config/hbm.cfg[/warn] file.


§f§eExpensive Mode:§f It makes everything more expensive, and it forces you to setup more automation, with more crafting intermediates. §r

§a528 Mod§r§ae:§f It gates progression similar to Factorio researches using an Annihilator. All AE2 Blocks explode when used, and a bunch of recipes are now luck-based. 

§4§f§4
Rampant Mode: §r§rThis mode makes Glyphids much stronger, more responsive to pollution, and also enables Scouts, allowing them to spread on their own.
[warn]
NOTE: In IQ Edition, this is even more dangerous in the Nether, as Nether Glyphids are by default much stronger than overworld glyphids, with some being resistant to fire or projectiles, and they respond to pollution 2x as fast.[/warn]§r

&q
328 Mode:§f 328 Mode combines ALL of the above modes, making your experience alot harder.

d2978cfa523644ad-bde18440e08b6bc6-5236-4.name: NTM Wiki
d2978cfa523644ad-bde18440e08b6bc6-5236-4.desc:
§aThe NTM Wi§r§aki§r is an extremely useful source of information for Base NTM and parts of NTM Space. It is available at [url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Main_Page[/url]

[warn]NOTE: The Wiki probably does not contain information on IQ-Edition specific features and changes. For that, we have this questbook.[/warn]

§6As per CC-BY-SA, Some specific quests in this questline may use or paraphrase lines from the NTM Wiki.§r

§0How TI was feeling when Tam69 Dropped:§

78524ceb3b414ba9-bde018fedc1195cd-3b41-4.name: Welcome!
78524ceb3b414ba9-bde018fedc1195cd-3b41-4.desc:
Welcome to §aIQ Edition: Official Pack!§r

This is an MIT Modpack made by &g&#008000&#00FF00iris-lgtm§r for the IQ Edition Fork of HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod.

This pack is a collection of mods meant to create an interesting experience with IQ Edition. If you're wondering what IQ Edition is, please check out [quest]What Is This?[/quest] 

&z&v&q&v- Doctor Rain§r&v§r§r

4d5380e63f5849aa-95e31f277432ed90-3f58-4.name: What Is This?
4d5380e63f5849aa-95e31f277432ed90-3f58-4.desc:
§6§lHBM's Nuclear Tech Mod§r is a large, multi-faceted tech mod for Minecraft 1.7.10
focusing on everything from exploration, lore, technology, weaponry, nuclear science, and more.§l §6§lNTM: Space§r is a fork of the original mod by JameH2 adding Space travel, as well as some custom lore and new machines & mechanics, making you have to do interplanetary automation for fully automating resources.

Now,§l §e§lIQ Edition§r§r §rwas originally a joke fork of NTM: Space started by Tam69 and iris-lgtm but it quickly gained more and more features, diverging from NTM: Space more and more over time.


Currently, it adds many new features, like§c Nether§r automation & biomes, An entirely new drug system and consumables rework,§d Magic and alchem§r§dy§r, a bunch of more machines and resources, and, hopefully, as it continues to be maintained, we shall see a large divergence from NTM Progression as a whole.

The goal of IQ Edition is to add things that the original NTM team would not want to focus on, or want in the upstream version of the mod, and hopefully feel different from base NTM.

That said, thanks for playing our fork, and i hope you'll enjoy this modpack I made :)

&q- Iris§r

d726bd5bdb354e82-a8fb03281eab4f66-db35-4.name: Arc Furnace
d726bd5bdb354e82-a8fb03281eab4f66-db35-4.desc:
The §6Electric Arc Furnace§r is a large bulk-smelting machine that can smelt up to 20 items at a time, even more with speed upgrades installed. It also has certain recipes exclusive to it, like smelting §8silicon§r and quartz glass.

It requires 3 §8electrodes§r to operate, and will always consume 1 durability per operation from all 3 electrodes, regardless of how many items were smelted. This means that it is more durability & power efficient to smelt as many at once as possible, and the Arc Furnace helps with this by providing a 5 slot input buffer for items to automatically fill up the furnace for maximum efficiency.

The Arc Furnace works in two modes: in §csolid§r mode, it smelts items directly into other items, but in §4liquid§r mode, it melts down the items into a §4molten material§r, which can flow in foundry channels and solidify inside casts just like the §4molten materials§r from the §6[quest]Crucible[/quest]§r.

The Arc Furnace is the only way for you to aqcuire §8silicon§r from smelting various §7silicates§r (sand, flint, asbestos, etc..) into §8silicon§r nuggets. It is also possible (and more efficient) to melt down some of these §7silicates§r into §8silicon§r using §4liquid§r mode, then cast them into billet molds.

44a01c0ac5284bbb-9d82a8c30b2e99cf-c528-4.name: Artillery Turret "Greg"
44a01c0ac5284bbb-9d82a8c30b2e99cf-c528-4.desc:
§6Artillery Turrets§r are a more powerful category of turrets, which include Greg and Henry.

Generally, artillery turrets can fire either in Cannon mode or in a Long-range mode, extending up to §e3,000 Blocks§r in range. They also have a "grace" zone, where entities aren't targetted.

Besides that,§6§r they also have a manual mode where they can be used with an§6 Artillery Designato§r§6r§r§r to designate hit-zones.
§r
Greg uses Artillery Shells, whereas Henry can fire rockets.

cb8a0d56206a419b-a22001eb6c6a73de-206a-4.name: Bakelite
cb8a0d56206a419b-a22001eb6c6a73de-206a-4.desc:
§6Bakelite§r is a useful resource that you obtain from basic Oil Processing. It is used in a wide array of machine recipes, like for the §6[quest]Arc Furnace[/quest]§r, which is required for further progression.

It can also be crafted into Insulation.

7f86d073cc344365-893aedac281b197e-cc34-4.name: Bedrock Ore Processing
7f86d073cc344365-893aedac281b197e-cc34-4.desc:
§6Bedrock Ore Processing§r is a processing line that involves finding various Bedrock Ore deposits on planets, drilling them with a Large Mining Drill, processing the ore using a §6Bedrock Ore Processor§r, and then processing the byproducts with various processes like Roasting and Washing into different byproducts.

As this is a very large processing line, you should read more about it on the NTM Wiki:

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Bedrock_Ore[/url]

b62fdb47105542ca-ae78b03a12bd7d47-1055-4.name: Catalytic Cracking Tower
b62fdb47105542ca-ae78b03a12bd7d47-1055-4.desc:
The §6Catalytic Cracking Tower§r is a non-powered Oil processing machine used to Crack different Oil products with §aSteam§r, producing Low-Pressure Steam as a byproduct.

It is used to process various Oil products into their more intrinsic forms, and is part of almost all the "Complete" Oil Processing lines.

It needs §eNiobium§r, which can be obtained in bulk from Tantalum processing.
