edfbba761f9d435b-91e124765d9158ed-1f9d-4.name: Centrifuge
edfbba761f9d435b-91e124765d9158ed-1f9d-4.desc:
The §6Centrifuge§r is a machine that is able to separate Ores and other things into 4 products. It is useful for getting more resources out of your ores without any added complexity.

It primarily takes in ores, crystals, and bedrock ores; but also has a few more "niche" recipes. One of the most useful of those recipes is centrifuging §7Rare Earth Chunks§r into §3boron§r, §5niobium§r, §9cobalt§r, and §ezirconium§r.

904664fad81f4640-aad495daf2f72f92-d81f-4.name: Choosing Polymer or Bakelite
904664fad81f4640-aad495daf2f72f92-d81f-4.desc: Once you have a decent §6Oil§r setup going, you will be able to fully automate §eBakelite§r. This is highly recommended over crafting Polymer, as it is almost entirely substituted for by Bakelite.

f0d46fafe39448d4-861722541b86d868-e394-4.name: Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT)
f0d46fafe39448d4-861722541b86d868-e394-4.desc:
The§6 Combined Cycle Gas Turbine§r or §6CCGT§r for short is an electricity-generating machine primarily meant for burning Gases, especially §bPetroleum Gas§r.

The CCGT burns §bgaseous fuels§r at §e100%§r efficiency, and is the only machine able to do so. It also needs a constant supply of §eEngine Lubricant§r to run, which is automatable using various methods.

Mind that the CCGT needs some time to warm up and cool down whenever it's turned on or off. After it's up and running, you can set the fuel consumption by sliding the handle on the left side.

The CCGT also has an §eAUTO§r button, which allows it to automatically throttle itself based on how much energy is in its buffer. Hence, if it is full of energy, it does not waste as much fuel. If it is fully empty, it will run on full speed.

It also is able to take in §9Water§r, as the turbine also produces some heat§r as a byproduct of burning fuel. It is able to heat this water into §eDense Steam§r, producing extra energy if you route it into §eTurbines§r.

4ed4c70659654634-bc9e58cc7c781063-5965-4.name: Derrick
4ed4c70659654634-bc9e58cc7c781063-5965-4.desc:
The §6Derrick§r is your first method of extracting Oil. When powered, it lowers down an Oil Extraction pipeline, and when it hits an Oil deposit it begins collecting§e Oil§r in its internal tanks, along with §9Natural Gas§r.

Oil deposits are §cnot§r infinite, but for an average Oil deposit, it is around §e12-24h§r worth of constant use (in real hours) before it runs out.


You can use §6Fracking §rto get truly infinite Oil, but that's for later.

33928fc76904404c-bd4d55de496d7687-6904-4.name: Desh
33928fc76904404c-bd4d55de496d7687-6904-4.desc:
§cDesh§r is a mid-game material created from Mercury and Rare Earth.
§r
It is incredibly tough, and able to create various unbreakable replacements for things like §eShredder Blades§r or §eStamps§r. It is also able to create §bunbreakable §rtools, however they are usually of a low Mining Level and are quite slow.

It is also used in various progression items, like the §d[quest]Desh Anvil[/quest]§r or §cthe Cracking Tower§r.

§6Desh Blend§r is a separate item that is used to craft§c Desh§r, you can get it in abundance by §eShredding§r or §eCentrifuging§r Rare Earth ore. You can also get it from combining various §aRare Earth Metals§r together.

You can get it via 3 methods:

- in a§e Chemplant§r with Light Oil (or Cracked Light Oil) and Mercury, alongside Desh Blend.
- Crafting Desh Blend with Coal Dust and Mercury Droplets to get Deshready, which can then be processed in an §6Acidizer§r to get the ingots.
- In a §9[quest]Rotary Furnace[/quest]§r, using Deshready and Light Oil.

f5cc01fcc09548d2-a580497bb7f4d785-c095-4.name: Desh Anvil
f5cc01fcc09548d2-a580497bb7f4d785-c095-4.desc:
The §cDesh Anvil§r is an upgraded Anvil that is able to do T3 recipes, most of which are required for further progression.

One of these T3 recipes allows you to craft §ePlates§r without a Press, which is immensely useful.

8c46ac83b29f4172-bff46d4552837f1d-b29f-4.name: Dew of the Garden
8c46ac83b29f4172-bff46d4552837f1d-b29f-4.desc: §6Dew of the Garden §ris an upgraded form of Sulfuric Acid that can be used to double the production of Military-Grade Circuits, and is, hence, highly recommended.

2200a75a38984c69-b464e44f61aedbd3-3898-4.name: Drone Linker
2200a75a38984c69-b464e44f61aedbd3-3898-4.desc: Drones are logistics and transport entities that can transport items

7377112294264c4a-b385f0332205a604-9426-4.name: Electric Heater
7377112294264c4a-b385f0332205a604-9426-4.desc:
The §6Electric Heate§r§6r§r is a Heat-Producing machine that allows you to generate heat from electricity. 

Using a [quest]Screwdriver[/quest] on it allows you to increase its consumption of electricity, but do note that it is highly inefficient compared to other methods of generating heat and not recommended for setups like§6 Boilers§r.

9c0883548f2b454e-99d03e0b29d25221-8f2b-4.name: Electric Press
9c0883548f2b454e-99d03e0b29d25221-8f2b-4.desc: The §6Electric Press§r is an upgrade to the Burner Press that can use Electricity to press items and can also accept Speed Upgrades.

b2ffda57342c443c-948bf66766559569-342c-4.name: Electrolysis Machine
b2ffda57342c443c-948bf66766559569-342c-4.desc:
The §6Electrolysis Machine§r is an electrical machine that allows you to electrolyse (or separate) fluids into their constituents as well as process various ore crystals.

The electrolysis machine has 2 functions: one for the separation of fluids and one for ore processing.

In the first mode, the machine will take in a compatible fluid and separate it into 2 other fluids.

In the second mode, It will process any Ore Crystal, allowing the maximum yield of the ore. There are 2 outputs for the molten main product (the outlet marked green) and the secondary (the one marked red), plus a byproduct kept in its item form (usually trace amounts of lithium). The outlets follow the same mechanics as the crucible's.

&qFun Fact§r: You can actually run both modes at once.

c8cd6bec9ad74d1b-b6a38ec0d07d06bc-9ad7-4.name: Flare Stack
c8cd6bec9ad74d1b-b6a38ec0d07d06bc-9ad7-4.desc:
The§6 Flare Stack§r is an energy-generating machine that is used mainly to §6void §rexcess fuel products, such as Natural Gas.

The Flare Stack will generate §e10%§r of the fluid's HE per bucket,§e 20%§r for gas fuels. It also has 2 buttons, one is a §bFlow Control Valve§r and one is an§b Ignition Valve§r.

Having the Flow Control Valve on and not the Ignition Valve will simply void the fluid. Having both on will generate energy.

5e946ca539ea4041-9ee912076e2bad40-39ea-4.name: Fluid Burner
5e946ca539ea4041-9ee912076e2bad40-39ea-4.desc:
The §6Fluid Burner§r is a Heat-Generating Machine that generates TU (Heat) from various fuels.

It has a fluid consumption rate, visible when looking at the machine. To change this, you can Sneak Right-Click it with a §e[quest]Screwdriver[/quest]§r to cycle the amount to a higher value.

d7a526df5dbf44cf-9c95b2a4032d3d16-5dbf-4.name: Fractioning Tower
d7a526df5dbf44cf-9c95b2a4032d3d16-5dbf-4.desc:
The§6 Fractioning Tower §ris an Oil Processing machine that allows you to Fraction a given liquid into 2 constituent liquids.

You right-click it with a§b Fluid ID§r to set the recipe, the Fluid ID must match the input of the recipe.

Several fractioning towers can be §estacked§r atop one another to speed up processing. Vertically stacked fractioning towers will push the input fluid up the stack while allowing the output fractions to flow downwards.
§6
Fractioning Tower Separator§r§6s§r are a decorative block that allow you to separate vertically stacked fractioning towers in an aesthetic manner.

15e7051e037f4676-afa8cfd4445a58bd-037f-4.name: Hydraulic Fracking Tower
15e7051e037f4676-afa8cfd4445a58bd-037f-4.desc:
The §6Hydraulic Fracking Tower§r is a machine capable of extracting infinite liquid from §6Bedrock Fluid Veins§r. These are found embedded in bedrock, and when you place a Hydraulic Fracking Tower above one of them, it will infinitely extract fluid from the vein without depleting it.

This is at the cost of it requiring more power, and also §bFracking Solution§r, which must be automated.

Every time oil is extracted, a grass, stone, or dirt block that is exposed to the sky is selected by a normal distribution and converted into a dead or oily version of itself. These block variations can support mustard willows but will kill any other plants on them and are affected by gravity like sand or gravel. In the §cNether§r, Netherrack will turn into Nether Glyphid blocks. This occurs in a 300~ block radius.

Here are the statistics for the Upgrades:
[img height=200]betterquesting:textures/fracking.png[/img]

91f5a557b24f4268-93eb9dbfca164642-b24f-4.name: Industrial Boiler
91f5a557b24f4268-93eb9dbfca164642-b24f-4.desc:
The §6Industrial Boiler§r is an advanced form of the [quest]Boiler[/quest], made in a [quest]Desh Anvil[/quest]. It has a much higher buffer than the base Boiler, being§e 4x §rlarger.

Unlike the regular Boiler, which explodes when the buffer is full, the Industrial Boiler §ccannot§r explode even if the buffer is full.

476115d9fd8a40ce-9428325ce26bef35-fd8a-4.name: Industrial Combustion Engine
476115d9fd8a40ce-9428325ce26bef35-fd8a-4.desc:
The §6Industrial Combustion Engine§r is an energy-generating machine that burns various fuels for power.

It is able to input a§e Piston Set§r, which changes how it interacts with various fuels.

[img height=200]betterquesting:textures/pistonsets.png[/img]

cdec415ba43e488b-967935da9a0552a4-a43e-4.name: Industrial Liquefaction Machine
cdec415ba43e488b-967935da9a0552a4-a43e-4.desc:
The §6Industrial Liquefaction Machine§r is an electrical machine that allows you to turn various items into liquids. 

It is used to create various PWR Coolants, and is the inverse of the [quest]Industrial Solidification Machine[/quest].

e0309b84a0c647e0-bb12d4ccc9dbc9a3-a0c6-4.name: Industrial Solidification Machine
e0309b84a0c647e0-bb12d4ccc9dbc9a3-a0c6-4.desc:
The §6Industrial Solidification Machine§r is an electrical machine that allows you to turn various liquids into items. 

It is mainly used to convert various liquid fuels into §eSolid Fuel§r and some types of unrefined §6Oil§r§6s§r into §eOil Ta§r§er§r.

It can also be used to turn §e[quest]Mercury[/quest]§r into §eMercury Droplets§r, which is important for automating it.

1a61f371778c4faf-9940412654bd1b00-778c-4.name: Integrated Circuit Board
1a61f371778c4faf-9940412654bd1b00-778c-4.desc:
Congratulations! You got your first Integrated Circuit Board.

§6Integrated Circuit Boards§r are generally actually cheaper than Analog Circuit Boards but need more infrastructure to make. They're used in various applications and are used for most machines going forward.

bfb2fd1b44a141d0-8869ccec0b64835d-44a1-4.name: Launch Pad
bfb2fd1b44a141d0-8869ccec0b64835d-44a1-4.desc:
The§e Launch Pad§r is a placeable pseudo-multiblock that lets you launch Missiles and other aeronautical things.

To launch a missile, you need a§6 Designator§r as well as its respective liquid fuel.

2ce5c55f1937481f-aee1c0e40006dea4-1937-4.name: Long Distance Energy Transport
2ce5c55f1937481f-aee1c0e40006dea4-1937-4.desc:
Once you have §6Refinery Power§r set up, they will often dwarf the existing power infrastructure you have at your main base. Hence, you will need to transport energy from your Refinery to your base.

This job of long-distance energy transport is done by the§e Large Energy Pylon.§r
Read more about it in the initial questline, [quest]Earlygame Progression[/quest].

2f63861f288544ce-8d9bc17e66264d8b-2885-4.name: Mercury
2f63861f288544ce-8d9bc17e66264d8b-2885-4.desc:
Mercury is a §7Heavy Metal§r usually found in liquid form. It is mainly used to create§c Desh§r, so it's required for progression. 

Some ways to get it are:

- Centrifuging§c Redstone Ore §r(silktouched) to get Mercury Droplets
- Mining §cCinnabar§r ore and then Roasting it in a [quest]Combination Oven[/quest]
- As a byproduct from §e[quest]Bedrock Ore Processing[/quest]§r
- Centrifuging §6Sulfur Crystals§r

ae5008f2a32642da-ad4436ed2b61eca5-a326-4.name: Microchips
ae5008f2a32642da-ad4436ed2b61eca5-a326-4.desc:
Microchips are an integral part of all the circuits you will be making from now on, namely the §2Integrated Circuit Board§r and the §4Military Grade Circuit Board§r.

You will need a §c§lLOT§r of them going forward, especially if you're planning to make a [quest]Bedrock Ore Processing[/quest] setup, so it is §ohighly§r reccomended that you automate silicon from sand (automate cobblestone using the [quest]Chemical Plant[/quest] recipe, then crush it twice to get sand).

4e4d37b063634c58-a938a58ba8d18b24-6363-4.name: Military Grade Circuit Board
4e4d37b063634c58-a938a58ba8d18b24-6363-4.desc: The §6Military-Grade Circuit Board§r is a version of the[quest]Integrated Circuit Board[/quest], used more for warfare-based applications than regular boards.

580c82585e334da4-a8fe7ae54cd2d599-5e33-4.name: Oil
580c82585e334da4-a8fe7ae54cd2d599-5e33-4.desc:
Welcome to§6 Midgame§r. This tier of progression is all about completing your first§e Oil Refinery§r, expanding your power production, and setting up larger industry.

To begin with, this questline assumes you've already found an Oil deposit. If you haven't found one yet, refer back to the [quest]Genesis[/quest] questline.

bae1a1a35f574a9d-9f6128aa1ebf86bf-5f57-4.name: Oil Power
bae1a1a35f574a9d-9f6128aa1ebf86bf-5f57-4.desc:
Processing §6Oil§r yields a variety of products which can be used as fuel. This quest branch shows you all of the machines that can process these fuels into energy.

Each machine supports only certain fuel grades at varying efficiencies, so you should see which one is best for your specific fuel.

288b75a89722472b-bb3f90809c822180-9722-4.name: Ore Acidizer
288b75a89722472b-bb3f90809c822180-9722-4.desc:
The Ore Acidizer is an electrical machine used to perform various recipes.

It requires a Fluid (usually an Acid, like Hydrogen Peroxide) and an Item, with Power.

6ed2df3413844c67-aec1861e647ff0e6-1384-4.name: Piping Fluids
6ed2df3413844c67-aec1861e647ff0e6-1384-4.desc:
When you set up an §6Oil Refinery§r, you have two options;

One, is to set up the machines near the §e[quest]Derrick[/quest]§r itself, and set up localised energy generation there.

The other is to pipe the fluids all the way back to your base. This is more convenient, as then actually building the Refinery will take less back-and-forth trips, but you will need to pipe fluids long distances.

The main options for piping fluids are §eBoxducts§r and §6Pipe Anchors§r. you can place §eBoxducts§r individually, but it will quickly become annoying to place for long distances.

§6Pipe Anchors§r can be directly connected from a §610m§r radius with a §6Pipe Wrench§r. §eShift Right-click §rand §eRight-click§r does the job of connecting them. They need to have a §bFluid ID§r to work. Pipe Anchors are decently good at long distance transport and less of a headache to place compared to Boxducts.

d7240234889547f8-89483c9987ac8e89-8895-4.name: Polymer
d7240234889547f8-89483c9987ac8e89-8895-4.desc:
§6Polymer§r is a useful resource that you obtain from basic Oil Processing. It is used in a wide array of machine recipes, like for the §6[quest]Arc Furnace[/quest]§r, which is required for further progression.

It can also be crafted into Insulation.

0a8375ccd8584ed3-b8cf1c1c62bb4208-d858-4.name: Pumpjack
0a8375ccd8584ed3-b8cf1c1c62bb4208-d858-4.desc: The §6Pumpjack§r is essentially an upgraded version of the §6[quest]Derrick[/quest]§r. It still isn't infinite, but it is§6 3x§r faster and produces §63x§r more oil than the Derrick. it does not produce anymore natural gas, though.

5fbe136442014743-aeaada6356985d54-4201-4.name: Radar
5fbe136442014743-aeaada6356985d54-4201-4.desc:
The §9Radar§r is a machine that can map terrain, designate targets for weaponry, and locate players and missiles above y+110.

You can use it with a Radar Linker and a Screen (or various electronics) to link it to them.

bb81b58e882a4dd4-be11023bb06cc4a2-882a-4.name: Redstone Fluid Valve
bb81b58e882a4dd4-be11023bb06cc4a2-882a-4.desc:
The§c Redstone Fluid Valve§r allows you to close or open a fluid duct when you supply power to the block. 

It can be used in tandem with Redstone-Over-Radio Transmitters to create auto-fluid management systems.

4f8affa4b9d14a33-82860d134fea4913-b9d1-4.name: Refinery
4f8affa4b9d14a33-82860d134fea4913-b9d1-4.desc:
The §6Refinery§r is an electrical machine which is able to refine Hot Oil (or any oil derivatives) into its byproducts. It outputs §b4§r Fluid byproducts, and §e1§r item byproduct.

The first Oil processing you will be doing will probably be§e Plain Crude Oil§r. Here is a diagram of how it is processed, you can follow it.

46e8b08ee60c45ed-938a2bd6a373b87e-e60c-4.name: Rubber
46e8b08ee60c45ed-938a2bd6a373b87e-e60c-4.desc:
§6Rubber§r is a stretchy polymer used for various late-game machines.

It requires§e Unsaturated Hydrocarbons§r to make which require Oil Cracking.

30de6140d7e748ec-874051ba2d9a3486-d7e7-4.name: Satan's Blood
30de6140d7e748ec-874051ba2d9a3486-d7e7-4.desc:
In the §cNether§r, you can find Nest biomes containing a lot of Bloatwisps, and Nether Glyphids, which are extremely dangerous variants of regular Glyphids.

However, in this biome, you can also find Bedrock Arteries. These are a form of Bedrock Fluid Vein which yield Satan's Blood when harvested with a §6Fracking Tower§r, alongside Argent Bloatpus.

§cSatan's Blood§r is an important resource which can be used to automate nearly all the§e Light Metals§r, like Iron and Copper. 

This is given in more detail in the chapter, [quest]Helldivers[/quest].

7ab3253b3e494331-a1b328e89aca13e2-3e49-4.name: Survey Scanner
7ab3253b3e494331-a1b328e89aca13e2-3e49-4.desc:
The §6Survey Scanner §ris a tool which lets you scan for special blocks underground. These include§e Coltan, Bedrock Oil, Bedrock Ore, Bedrock Arteries, Australium, and Depth Rock§r.

Right-clicking this onto a §6Beryllium Block§r with an §dEntanglement Kit §rwill allow you to teleport to the End.

7785b026af634074-a5721033c162bd57-af63-4.name: Tanks
7785b026af634074-a5721033c162bd57-af63-4.desc:
To store larger amounts of fluid, you will need to create§6 Tanks§r.

These function the same as barrels, but they are larger, and able to hold considerably more fluid.

bda66d4993ae4dc8-98ce1c8072f99cb0-93ae-4.name: The Factory Must Grow
bda66d4993ae4dc8-98ce1c8072f99cb0-93ae-4.desc: This information questline diverges into a few important machines that you unlock that are important to expanding your industrialisation.

1847804247db44e2-8d393d7813cc6a5f-47db-4.name: Turbofan
1847804247db44e2-8d393d7813cc6a5f-47db-4.desc:
The §6Turbofan§r is an electricity-generating machine that is primarily for the burning of Aviation fuels, like§d Kerosene §rand §dJet Fuel§r.

Standing infront of it can pull you into its blades and§c kill you§r, and if you are not careful, it may also§4 delete §rall your items.

If it has an §6Afterburner§r upgrade, the fire coming out of the back can also burn entities.

Killed entities are harvested for 1,000mB of §cBlood§r, which can be piped out of the Turbofan.

The upgrade statistics are listed below:
[img height=300]betterquesting:textures/turbofan.png[/img]

4c214a178ae44438-b2febeba75d2d6c4-8ae4-4.name: Turrets
4c214a178ae44438-b2febeba75d2d6c4-8ae4-4.desc: Integrated Circuit Boards allow you to gain access to some new turrets, such as Mr. Friendly. However, to use them, you still need §6Turret-ID Chips.§r§6

9f6134d2994b4392-811ea9cb466ea3f4-994b-4.name: Weapon Steel
9f6134d2994b4392-811ea9cb466ea3f4-994b-4.desc:
§6Weapon Steel§r is an important resource which helps you create more powerful Guns and other equipment.

You need to make it in a §e[quest]Rotary Furnace[/quest]§r with Coker Gas.
